newsitem.title: FINLAND: WSOY TO SET J/V WITH FINNISH LAWYERS.
newsitem.headline: WSOY TO SET J/V WITH FINNISH LAWYERS.

text.p: Finnish publishing and printing house Werner Soderstrom Osakeyhtio - WSOY said in a statement on Wednesday it would set up a joint venture with the Finnish bar association (SLY) to publish law books.
"The company's share capital will be three million markka of which WSOY will subscribe 90 percent and SLY 10 percent," WSOY said.
WSOY also acquired the rights for the joint venture to publish a Finnish law encyclopedia; Encyclopaedia Iuridica Fennica (EIF).
